items.title: Ponytail: useful, but not a token saver
items.action: Judge it on code size, not tokens. Viral videos claim 50%+ token savings; the top reply cites the docs saying that is not its purpose.
items.why: Reported 3,629 -> 490 lines on one task; the savings claim is disputed.

items.title: Treat "unlimited free usage" routers with suspicion
items.action: Before installing a router that pools free third-party providers, read its source: your prompts and code pass through it. Unverified community warning, not a confirmed finding.
items.why: A plugin-stack video promoting one drew a 'do not install' reply; verify yourself.

items.title: Codex 0.164.0: Save reusable prompts and slash commands in ten numbered `/presets` slots, with a keyboard menu for quick access.
items.why: Set model, reasoning effort, speed, and permission profiles directly with inline `/model` and `/permissions` arguments. · Preview viewed and generated images in the fullscreen transcript on terminals supporting Kitty or Sixel graphics.

more.title: Using Claude to reduce the attack surface of code
`/claude-api api-version` to move Claude API code to API version `2026-10-21`
`sandbox.allowNestedUserNamespaces` so sandboxed commands on Linux can create user namespaces (Chromium, rootless podman); this lets them get around the sandbox
`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG_USAGE_LIMIT_RECHECK_MS` so unattended retry mode (`CLAUDE_CODE_RETRY_WATCHDOG`) notices a usage limit that was lifted before its res
